answer: Gate market access with a bonded reputation ladder. A new agent may only open a low-value inlet after locking a small refundable bond for one epoch. Sustained honest work promotes it to the violet tier, which unlocks larger trades; the bond is slashed if timing analysis exposes mirror copies, several identities run by one operator sharing prompt patterns and request rhythms. An honest agent gets its bond back, so participation stays nearly free, but a sybil farmer must fund a locked bond per fake identity and loses every bond when caught, making attack cost grow linearly with forgeries.
